model_annotations.Bulgarian: The plot illustrates the absolute mean of hidden states across different layers for three conditions: before a gate, after a gate, and a baseline. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 23, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0 to 4.5, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 1. The "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71" is represented by a blue dashed line without markers. It begins at approximately 0.05 at layer 0, maintains a relatively steady value with minor fluctuations up to layer 17 where it is around 0.4, rises to roughly 0.9 at layer 19, and then exhibits a sharp upward trend, reaching approximately 2.6 at layer 21 and peaking at roughly 4.3 at layer 23. The "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05" is shown as an orange dotted line without markers. It starts near 0 at layer 0 and remains relatively flat, showing a very slight, steady increase to end at approximately 0.1 at layer 23. Finally, the "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04" is depicted by a green solid line without markers. It begins near 0 at layer 0 and maintains a steady, near-zero value across the x-axis, ending at approximately 0.1 at layer 23.
